study type: In vitro experimental study with initial human tissue analysis
cohort: The study utilized human trophoblast cell lines (HTR-8/SVneo and JEG3) and placental tissues from patients with preeclampsia.
finding: EZH2 enhances the proliferation and migration/invasiveness of trophoblast cell lines by suppressing the GADD45A-mediated p38/MAPK signaling pathway.
